Suhyeon Lee

M.S. Student @KAIST

I'm a master's student in Management Engineering at KAIST, advised by Prof. Donghyuk Shin, with research interests at the intersection of AI and human behavior. I recently completed a visiting program at Carnegie Mellon University's AI Intensive Program. My work focuses on understanding how humans interact with and adapt to emerging technologies, particularly through LLM-based social simulation and AI regulation research.
